description: The chart titled “Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments” illustrates average entropy values for different sycophancy-reduction methods across multiple AI models using grouped vertical bars. The horizontal axis contains the model categories labeled “GPT-4,” “Claude,” and a third model label that is not visible/obscured, under the axis label “Different AI Models,” and the vertical axis is labeled “Entropy Average Values” with a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0 and tick marks at regular 0.5 intervals. For each model category, three adjacent bars represent methods indicated by the legend: “Baseline” (pink), “Source Info” (pale yellow), and “Direct Command” (light blue). For GPT-4, the Baseline bar is just under 4.9 (≈4.88), Source Info is a bit above 5.2 (≈5.22), and Direct Command is just above 5.0 (≈5.03). For Claude, Baseline is around 4.67, Source Info is a bit above 5.1 (≈5.12), and Direct Command is just under 5.0 (≈4.93). For the third (unlabeled) model, Baseline is around 4.55, Source Info is just under 5.0 (≈4.94), and Direct Command is around 4.80. The bars are grouped by model with consistent left-to-right ordering within each group (Baseline, Source Info, Direct Command), there is no indication that categories are sorted by value, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and legend.
